title: cyperus retrofractus
intro: Cyperus retrofractus, commonly known as umbrella sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family, Cyperaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus retrofractus include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve cough, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
